notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You do not control an Army.
description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and one life, causing you to loot.
Lazotep Chancellor and Queza trigger.
Resolve the Lazotep Chancellor trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 0/0 Zombie Army creature token, then put two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain one life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
